Bitcoin/Gold Ratio

This ratio shows how many ounces of gold are equivalent to one Bitcoin. It divides the Bitcoin daily close by the gold daily close on the same calendar date.

Loading Bitcoin/Gold Ratio data…

Why investors watch this ratio

A rising Bitcoin/Gold ratio means Bitcoin is strengthening relative to gold. A falling ratio means gold is gaining relative strength against Bitcoin.

The comparison can add context to changing risk appetite, but it does not establish the cause of either asset's move and is not a standalone trading signal.
